license_message: Sign in inside the RONE Plugins Center to unlock your plugins. Bought or claimed a plugin but never set a password? Sign in with that e-mail and we will send you the link to set one. New here? 7-day free trial at roneaudio.com.

center_installer.whats_new: 2.1.3 (Mac): Settings > Updates without a password. One button moves your RONE plugins from the system folders into your own (one last password), and from then on every update installs with no password. 2.1.2: when an install fails, the Center now says why - and how to fix it - instead of 'installer code 0'. 2.1.1 (Mac): a plugin whose user folder (~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3 or Components) the Center may not write to - often made by another company's installer - now installs system-wide with your password instead of failing with 'Permission denied'.

plugins.name: RONE Reverse Reverb
plugins.description: Tempo-synced reverse reverb for risers, vocal swells and seamless transitions - tail lengths from 1/32 to 8 bars, shaped with fades, filters and stereo width
plugins.whats_new: 1.1.15 - The sound you drop in can now be up to 30 seconds long (it was 8). With two Reverse Reverb windows open, closing one no longer stops drag and drop in the other, and the Default preset now recalls the settings a new instance opens with.

pt.description: Reverb reverso sincronizado ao tempo para risers, swells de voz e transições sem emenda - caudas de 1/32 a 8 compassos, moldadas com fades, filtros e largura estéreo

es.description: Reverb inverso sincronizado al tempo para risers, swells de voz y transiciones sin cortes - colas de 1/32 a 8 compases, moldeadas con fades, filtros y anchura estéreo

plugins.name: RONE Stutter
plugins.description: Tempo-locked stutter engine - beat divisions, sculpted fade curves and stereo movement for instant fills, edits and glitch builds
plugins.whats_new: 1.5.9 - A project whose sample was moved or deleted now opens with SOURCE NOT FOUND and keeps the file's path, clips dragged in from Cubase are kept in a permanent folder so the project still opens later, and two Stutter windows open at once no longer break drag and drop.

pt.description: Motor de stutter travado no tempo - divisões de batida, curvas de fade esculpidas e movimento estéreo para fills, edits e builds glitch na hora

es.description: Motor de stutter fijado al tempo - divisiones de pulso, curvas de fade esculpidas y movimiento estéreo para fills, edits y builds glitch al instante

plugins.name: RONE Stucker
plugins.description: One knob that grabs the loop and rolls it up - the captured slice shrinks tighter and tighter until it screams, then lets go right back into the beat
plugins.whats_new: 1.3.4 - A RIDE started while the song is stopped now counts from the bar where playback starts, the lock screen's OPEN RONE PLUGINS CENTER button finds the Center wherever it is installed, and the plugin looks right without an internet connection.

pt.description: Um knob que agarra o loop e o enrola - a fatia capturada encolhe cada vez mais até gritar, e então solta de volta no beat

es.description: Un knob que atrapa el loop y lo enrolla - la porción capturada se encoge cada vez más hasta gritar, y luego suelta de vuelta al beat

plugins.name: RONE Throw
plugins.description: One knob that throws anything into a tempo-locked atmosphere - a dotted-8th ping-pong delay whose band-limited feedback loop stays clean at near-infinite feedback, so the wash sits behind the mix instead of muddying it
plugins.whats_new: 1.8.4 - MIDI macro recall now sets only the controls a macro stores, hosts that send very large audio blocks no longer lose the effect, and the plugin looks right without an internet connection.

pt.description: Um knob que joga qualquer som numa atmosfera travada no tempo - um delay ping-pong de colcheia pontuada cujo feedback limitado em banda fica limpo mesmo quase infinito, então a cauda fica atrás da mix sem embolar

es.description: Un knob que lanza cualquier sonido a una atmósfera fijada al tempo - un delay ping-pong de corchea con puntillo cuyo feedback limitado en banda sigue limpio casi infinito, así la cola queda detrás de la mezcla sin embarrarla

plugins.name: RONE Clipper
plugins.description: FREE plugin - sign in to the Center with a free RONE account and it unlocks. A hard clipper that shows you exactly what it cut: the waveform after the clip stage with the removed peaks in blue, one CLIP knob, LOW CUT that keeps kick and bass out of the clipper, and integer-latency oversampling that nulls against the input at -100 dB
plugins.whats_new: 1.0.5 - The Windows standalone has an AUDIO button for audio and MIDI settings, and the window is lighter on the CPU.

pt.description: Um hard clipper que mostra exatamente o que cortou: a forma de onda depois do clip com os picos removidos em azul, um knob CLIP, LOW CUT que mantém kick e baixo fora do clipper, e oversampling que zera contra a entrada a -100 dB

es.description: Un hard clipper que te muestra exactamente lo que cortó: la forma de onda tras el clip con los picos eliminados en azul, un knob CLIP, LOW CUT que deja el kick y el bajo fuera del clipper, y oversampling que se anula contra la entrada a -100 dB

plugins.name: RONE Rise
plugins.description: One knob, the whole build-up: turn INTENSITY up over the phrase and the mix becomes a rise (a steep high-pass, a big reverb, echoes, noise, a barber-pole climb), snap it to zero and the drop hits with the reverb still spilling into it - or press GO and let it land on the bar by itself
plugins.whats_new: 1.0.6 - The Windows standalone has an AUDIO button for audio and MIDI settings, automating PRESET is handled more safely, and the window is lighter on the CPU.

pt.description: Um knob, o build-up inteiro: suba o INTENSITY ao longo da frase e a mix vira um rise (high-pass íngreme, reverb grande, ecos, ruído, uma subida infinita), zere no drop e o reverb ainda transborda nele - ou aperte GO e deixe pousar no compasso sozinho

es.description: Un knob, todo el build-up: sube INTENSITY a lo largo de la frase y la mezcla se vuelve un rise (high-pass pronunciado, gran reverb, ecos, ruido, una subida infinita), llévalo a cero en el drop y la reverb aún se derrama en él - o pulsa GO y deja que aterrice en el compás solo

plugins.name: RONE Iron
plugins.description: Drop a vocal and it becomes a metallic chop instrument: Iron flattens it to the note you pick, slices it into chops on your MIDI keys, rings each chop through a comb tuned to that note and throws it left and right - play it from the piano roll or let the GROOVE engine write the pattern
plugins.whats_new: 1.0.6 - Closing a project while a vocal is still loading is instant again, a project whose stored vocal is damaged loads the original file from its folder, and drags from Cubase, Nuendo or Logic no longer overwrite each other when two clips share a name.

pt.description: Solte um vocal e ele vira um instrumento de chops metálicos: o Iron afina na nota que você escolhe, fatia em chops nas suas teclas MIDI, faz cada chop ressoar num comb afinado e o joga para os lados - toque no piano roll ou deixe o GROOVE escrever o padrão

es.description: Suelta una voz y se convierte en un instrumento de chops metálicos: Iron la afina a la nota que elijas, la corta en chops en tus teclas MIDI, hace sonar cada chop en un comb afinado y lo lanza a izquierda y derecha - tócalo desde el piano roll o deja que GROOVE escriba el patrón

plugins.name: RONE Flanger
plugins.description: A transition riser flanger - sweep it by hand or engage INFINITE barberpole mode for endless bar-locked rises and falls, with feedback, stereo offset and a rhythmic gate
plugins.whats_new: 2.1.1 - AUTO GAIN keeps working in hosts that send empty audio blocks, at high FEEDBACK the ring now stops when you stop the song while bounces keep the real tail, a user preset saved under a factory preset's name now loads, and the Windows standalone has an AUDIO button for audio and MIDI settings. 2.1.0 - INFINITE starts its sweep from the same point every time you switch it on - by hand, by automation, or when you press play with it already on - instead of wherever the song happened to be in the cycle, which could start a riser in the middle or at the end. Automate INFINITE on the bar where the rise should begin and it climbs the same way every time; the start lands on the nearest 1/16, so automation drawn on the bar line starts exactly there. A loop that jumps back before that point starts the sweep again. 2.0.9 - On older Macs (Safari before 14.1) the window's controls now sit where they belong: labels inside their knobs, rows spaced, nothing in a corner. 2.0.8 - INFINITE has three new lengths: 32 BAR and 16 BAR for long builds, 1/4 (one beat) for a fast shimmer - eight in all, from 32 bars down to a quarter bar. Projects and presets saved with an older version open on the length they had; only automation drawn on the sweep length in an older project needs redrawing. 2.0.7 - FIX: OUTPUT works while you play. Turning it, or automating it, now changes the level at once (with a 20 ms ramp) instead of only after the audio restarted. GATE no longer clicks: the effect fades in and out over 5 ms right on the grid line, where it used to switch hard on the edge of the audio buffer (up to a whole buffer late), and the flanger keeps running while the gate is closed, so every pulse comes back clean. 2.0.6 - UPDATE NOTICE: when a newer version is out, the plugin says so as it opens. UPDATE hands it to the Plugins Center, which installs it as soon as your DAW lets go of the plugin (closing the DAW always does); until then the plugin is grey and your settings stay as they are. LATER hides the note for three days. 2.0.5 - the mouse wheel moves every knob (shift = fine); the About panel's texts are readable. Host automation now moves the knobs. The interface follows the plugin's own parameters live, so an automation clip, a host preset recall or a second open window all show up on screen instead of leaving the controls frozen where you last left them. Every move you make is also wrapped in an automation gesture now, so hosts in Touch or Latch record it properly.

pt.description: Um flanger de transição - varra na mão ou ligue o modo INFINITE para subidas e descidas sem fim travadas no compasso, com feedback, offset estéreo e um gate rítmico

es.description: Un flanger de transición - barre a mano o activa el modo INFINITE para subidas y bajadas sin fin fijadas al compás, con feedback, offset estéreo y un gate rítmico

plugins.name: RONE AFTERSPACE
plugins.description: Creative reverb, delay and atmosphere designer - huge cinematic spaces that stay clean via built-in ducking, a tail de-esser (SILK), auto-gain and tempo-synced echo, all in one plugin
plugins.whats_new: 1.0.5 - Preset clicks and one-click controls are now recorded by DAW automation, and the standalone has an AUDIO button for audio and MIDI settings.

pt.description: Designer criativo de reverb, delay e atmosfera - espaços cinematográficos enormes que ficam limpos com ducking embutido, de-esser na cauda (SILK), auto-gain e eco sincronizado, tudo num plugin só

es.description: Diseñador creativo de reverb, delay y atmósfera - espacios cinematográficos enormes que se mantienen limpios con ducking integrado, de-esser en la cola (SILK), auto-gain y eco sincronizado, todo en un solo plugin

plugins.name: RONE Analyzer
plugins.description: Professional measurement suite: 30-band spectrum with reference-track comparison, vectorscope, level meters, EBU R128 loudness and bit statistics
plugins.whats_new: 1.3.15 - REFERENCE has a strip of its own under the correlation meter: load a record and its waveform comes up with the tempo found for you; the curve on the Spectrogram is taken from a loop of 16 bars - it opens on the loudest one, the arrows move it 16 bars at a time and a click puts it anywhere, so you compare against the part with every layer in. The vectorscope draws the signal as a glowing trace with a soft cloud around it. Appearance > Customize sets the SIDES colour. The overs are two red clip lamps. The bar scope stays on the sum. On a Mac the title bar no longer shows a title that sat off to one side. 1.3.14 - MAX PEAK and MAX RMS now sit at the top of the LEVEL METERS, read exactly the way StandardCLIP reads them - the largest sample, and the RMS averaged over 217 ms, louder channel - so a kick shows the same numbers in both; click either to reset them. SIDES on the Spectrogram paints the side signal over the bars in violet: what is wide, band by band. Fainter lines at every 5 dB (Appearance > Spectrum 5 dB lines hides them). In the BAR SCOPE, a slide off the grid now shows as an amber OFFSET chip - click it to put the kicks back on the beat. On older Macs the bar scope and the level meters draw whole again (they showed only the tips of each kick, or nothing). The correlation meter's white tick is gone. 1.3.13 - The meters keep drawing on older Macs, a second Analyzer Bridge no longer scrambles the readings, the window always opens on screen, and if the Analyzer ever crashes the report reaches us through the Plugins Center.

pt.description: Suíte de medição profissional: espectro de 30 bandas com comparação a uma faixa de referência, vectorscope, medidores de nível, loudness EBU R128 e estatísticas de bits

es.description: Suite de medición profesional: espectro de 30 bandas con comparación con una pista de referencia, vectorscopio, medidores de nivel, loudness EBU R128 y estadísticas de bits

tips.text: End the bar with a Throw: automate THROW up on the last beat only, on a dry sound, and let the tail carry the transition.

i18n.pt: Termine o compasso com um Throw: automatize o THROW só no último tempo, num som seco, e deixe a cauda levar a transição.
i18n.es: Cierra el compás con un Throw: automatiza THROW solo en el último tiempo, sobre un sonido seco, y deja que la cola lleve la transición.

tips.text: Draw the Stucker knob up exactly on the hit you want caught: it grabs what starts where the knob comes up, every time.

i18n.pt: Desenhe o knob do Stucker subindo exatamente no hit que você quer capturar: ele pega o que começa onde o knob sobe, sempre.
i18n.es: Dibuja el knob de Stucker subiendo justo en el golpe que quieres atrapar: atrapa lo que empieza donde sube el knob, siempre.

tips.text: Turn Rise up over the last 8 bars and snap it to zero on the drop: the reverb still spills into the first hit.

i18n.pt: Suba o Rise nos últimos 8 compassos e zere no drop: o reverb ainda transborda no primeiro hit.
i18n.es: Sube Rise en los últimos 8 compases y llévalo a cero en el drop: la reverb aún se derrama en el primer golpe.

tips.text: Turn LOW CUT up so the kick and bass stay out of the clipper, then push CLIP until the blue only touches the transients.

i18n.pt: Suba o LOW CUT para o kick e o baixo ficarem fora do clipper, depois empurre o CLIP até o azul só tocar os transientes.
i18n.es: Sube LOW CUT para que el kick y el bajo queden fuera del clipper, luego empuja CLIP hasta que el azul solo toque los transitorios.

tips.text: Put Reverse Reverb on the last word before the drop: the swell runs straight into the hit, with no gap.

i18n.pt: Coloque o Reverse Reverb na última palavra antes do drop: o swell entra direto no hit, sem buraco.
i18n.es: Pon Reverse Reverb en la última palabra antes del drop: el swell entra directo en el golpe, sin hueco.

tips.text: INFINITE at 32 BAR gives a rise that never stops climbing: automate MIX up over the build.

i18n.pt: O INFINITE em 32 BAR dá um rise que nunca para de subir: automatize o MIX ao longo do build.
i18n.es: INFINITE en 32 BAR da un rise que nunca deja de subir: automatiza MIX a lo largo del build.
